## Topline Numbers By Mission

:::{.column-screen-inset}

```{python}
#| label: by_mission_tbl_func

def fn_tbl_by_mission(df_time_entries):
    st_dt = min(df_time_entries.select(pl.col('start'))[:,'start'].str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date())
    en_dt = max(df_time_entries.select(pl.col('start'))[:,'start'].str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date())
    d = df_time_entries.group_by(
        ['toggl_user_name', 'client_name']
    ).agg(
        (pl.sum('duration') / 3600).alias('hours')
    ).filter(
        ~pl.col('client_name').is_null(),
        ~pl.col('client_name').eq('PTO')
    ).select(
        pl.col('toggl_user_name').alias('Analyst'),
        pl.col('client_name').alias('Mission'),
        pl.col('hours'),
        (pl.col('hours') / pl.sum('hours').over('toggl_user_name')).alias('percent')
    ).pivot(
        on='Analyst',
        index='Mission',
        values=[ 'hours', 'percent' ]
    ).sort('Mission').select(
        pl.col('Mission'),
        cs.ends_with('Adam'),
        cs.ends_with('Dann')
    )
    #
    t = gt(d).cols_label(
        Mission="Mission",
        hours_Dann="Hours",
        hours_Adam="Hours",
        percent_Adam="Percent of Total",
        percent_Dann="Percent of Total"
    ).fmt_percent(
        columns=cs.starts_with('percent'),
        decimals=1
    ).fmt_number(
        columns=cs.starts_with('hour'),
        decimals=1
    ).tab_spanner(
        columns=cs.ends_with('Adam'),
        label="Adam"
    ).tab_spanner(
        columns=cs.ends_with('Dann'),
        label="Dann"
    ).sub_missing(
        columns = cs.all(),
        missing_text = '---'
    )
    #
    #I don't know why this isn't working, but it's not, so excluding for now
    #.tab_footnote(
    #    f"Only includes entries from {start_date.strftime('%x')} to {end_date.strftime('%x')}.\nExcludes PTO time."
    #)
    return t
```

## Last 30 Days

```{python}
#| label: tbl-last-30-days
#| tbl-cap: Distribution of Time by Mission - Last Month
end_date = max(df_time_entries.select(pl.col('start'))[:,'start'].str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date())
start_date = end_date - datetime.timedelta(days=30)
df_last_30_days = df_time_entries.filter(
    pl.col('start').str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date().is_between(start_date, end_date)
)
fn_tbl_by_mission(df_last_30_days)
```
Only includes entries from `{python} start_date.strftime('%x')` to `{python} end_date.strftime('%x')`. Excludes PTO time.

## Over Time

```{python}
#| label: fig-overtime-bars
#| fig-cap: Hours Logged by Mission Over Time
#| fig-align: 'center'
df_gg_by_month_client = (
    df_time_entries
    .filter(
        ~pl.col('client_name').is_null(),
        ~pl.col('client_name').eq('PTO')
    )
    .group_by(['month', 'client_name'])
    .agg((pl.sum('duration') / 3600).alias('hours'))
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col('hours') / pl.sum('hours').over('month')).alias('percent')
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col('percent').map_elements(lambda value: f"{value:.1%}", return_dtype=pl.String).alias("percent_label")
    )
    .filter(~pl.col('hours').is_nan())
)
df_gg_by_month = (
    df_gg_by_month_client
    .group_by('month')
    .agg(pl.sum('hours'))
    .with_columns(
        pl.col('hours').ceil().cast(pl.Int32).alias('hours_label')
    )
)

gg_by_month_client = pn.ggplot(
    df_gg_by_month_client,
    pn.aes(
        x='month',
        y='hours',
        fill='client_name',
        label='percent_label'
    )
) + pn.geom_bar(
    stat='identity',
    position='stack',
    color='black'
) + pn.geom_text(
    position = pn.position_stack(vjust = 0.5)
) + pn.geom_text(
    data = df_gg_by_month,
    mapping = pn.aes(
        label = 'hours_label',
        fill = None
    ),
    nudge_y = 10
) + pn.scale_y_continuous(
    name = 'Hours Logged',
    expand = (0, 0, 0, 20)
) + pn.scale_x_date(
    name = 'Month',
    date_breaks = '1 month',
    date_labels = '%b %Y'
) + pn.scale_fill_brewer(
    name = 'Mission',
    breaks = [
        'Administrative/Leadership', 'Clinical', 'Education', 
        'Research: Externally Funded', 'Research: UW/DEM Funded'],
    type = 'qualitative',
    palette = 6
) + pn.labs(
    caption = 'Summed across Dann and Adam; Excludes PTO.'
) + pn.theme_minimal()

gg_by_month_client
```

## Externally Funded Research (Only Dann)

```{python}
j=(df_time_entries
    .filter(
        pl.col('client_name').eq("Research: Externally Funded"),
        pl.col('toggl_user_name').eq('Dann')
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col('month').str.to_date().dt.strftime('%b %Y').alias('fmonth')
    )
    .group_by(['project_name', 'month', 'fmonth'])
    .agg((pl.sum('duration') / 3600).alias('hours'))
    .sort(['month'])
    .drop(['month'])
    .pivot(['fmonth'], values=['hours'])
)
gt(j).cols_label(
    project_name="Grant"
).fmt_number(
    columns=cs.exclude('project_name'),
    decimals=1
)
```

## Data Integrity Checks

### Missing Client Names

```{python}
#| label: tbl-data_integrity_checks
#| tbl-cap: Data Integrity Check - Missing Mission
gt(df_time_entries.filter(
    pl.col('client_name').eq('') |
    pl.col('client_name').is_null()
).select(['id', 'toggl_user_name', 'description', 'start', 'project_name'])
).cols_label(
    id="Time Entry ID",
    toggl_user_name="Toggl User Name",
    description="Description",
    start="Start Time",
    project_name="Project Name"
).fmt_date(
    columns="start", 
    date_style="wd_m_day_year"
)
```

### Invalid Client Names
```{python}
#| label: tbl-data_integrity_checks2
#| tbl-cap: Data Integrity Check - Unmapped Mission Label
gt(df_time_entries.filter(
    ~pl.col('client_name').is_in([
        "Research: Externally Funded",
        "Education",
        "Administrative/Leadership",
        "Research: UW/DEM Funded",
        "Clinical",
        "PTO"
    ])).select(
        ['id', 'toggl_user_name', 'description', 'start', 'project_name', 'client_name']
    )
).cols_label(
    id="Time Entry ID",
    toggl_user_name="Toggl User Name",
    description="Description",
    start="Start Time",
    project_name="Project Name",
    client_name="Client Name"
).fmt_date(
    columns="start",
    date_style="wd_m_day_year"
)

```
